During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''Shadow Guard''' was in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and trained in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], the [[Shadow Guard]] was one of the Empire's most feared servants. Armed with a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]], the guard [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]].
